checks: Verified original §2, equation (2). The point (z,y) is fixed, but need not be sampled or satisfy an anchored body condition for the argument.

Full and empty are classified by volume. The support inequalities have the stated signs, preserve those masses, and allow a null supporting section in the empty class. The proper equality preserves the whole proper trace. The original tilt is feasible in every pattern.

The continuous norm sphere is compact and each proper scalar is between the bounded full and empty right sides. There are finitely many matrices of rows ±(p−z), including zero rows. The minimum-norm independent-active-set formula gives a uniform bound over those patterns and displacement interval.
The clamped minimizing sequence has a convergent subsequence, with a nonzero limiting normal. Fiber-volume-null limiting cutting planes give continuity of cap masses by dominated convergence.
